meta.description: Automate Accelo tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动操作 Accelo 中的任务与项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Accelo 管理项目和客户，需要自动化常规操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate tasks and projects in Accelo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Accelo to manage projects and clients and need to automate routine operations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Rube MCP 自动搜索当前可用的 Accelo 工具和连接状态，然后按最新 schema 执行你要求的 Accelo 操作（如创建、查询、更新等）。
howto.when: 当你提出与 Accelo 相关的操作请求（如创建客户、查询项目、更新任务等）时触发。Claude 会先搜索工具并验证连接，再执行。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 Accelo 客户，名字叫 ABC 公司。
say.note: Claude 会搜索创建客户工具并执行。
会搜索并调用查询工具。

say.text: 在 Accelo 中新建一个任务，分配给张三。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use Rube MCP to automatically search for current available Accelo tools and connection status, then execute your requested Accelo operations (e.g., create, query, update) using the latest schemas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you make Accelo-related requests (e.g., create a client, query projects, update tasks). Claude will first search tools and verify connection before executing.

say_en.text: Create an Accelo client named ABC Company.
say_en.note: Claude will search for the create client tool and execute.

say_en.text: Query all projects from last week.
say_en.note: Will search and call the query tool.

say_en.text: Create a new task in Accelo assigned to Zhang San.
say_en.note: Will search for the create task tool.
